g.title: HR_OBJMETRICTEMPLATE
g.text: Objective Metric Template - This entity further describes an Objective Template with the Kpi that it will be measured by.
The rating scale is used to assess the metric using discrete values.
This field specifies what is the type of target, for example if it is an amount, a deadline etc.
It's the unit of measure of the Target/Result.
The identifier of the currency record.
When this flag is activated, the user will specify beyond the target also other intermediate achievements below or up the target.
The mapping between an achievement percentage and a bonus payout percentage.
This flag determines if the metric target points will be interpolated.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_OBJECTIVETEMPLATE
g.text: Objective Template - Objective templates are examples/models that a user can start from when creating an Objective in a plan.
Objective type determines if it is qualitative or quantitative.
The rating scale is used to assess the objective using discrete values.
The category is a logical group for the objective.
Whit this flag activated, the Objective will be measured/made by one Kpi only.
This flag states if the template is still active and can be used to create objectives from it.
This flag states that this template can be used by a Manager to create/assign team objectives starting from it.
This flag states that this template can be used by an employee self service to self assign goals.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
